sentences.text:
Author: Samit Gopal
Bench: Samit Gopal

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Court No. - 69 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 1258 of 2023 Applicant :- Mohd Azam Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Amrita Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Fatma Khatoon Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Pradeep Kumar Sharma, Advocate, holding brief of Ms. Amrita Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Ms. Fatma Khatoon, Advocate, for the opposite party no. 2 who has filed her vakalatnama in the office on 13.1.2022 but the same is not record, Sri B.B. Upadhyay, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.
Office is directed to trace out the vakalatnama of Ms. Fatma Khatoon and place it on record and make a note about it in the order sheet.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Mohd. Azam with the prayer to quash the entire proceeding as well as impugned charge sheet dated 16.5.2022 and cognizance order dated 4.7.2022 in Criminal Case No. 593 of 2022 (State vs. Mohd. Azam and Mohd Azam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62176480/
1 others), arising out of Case Crime No. 106 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 406 I.P.C.
and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Saidpur, District Ghazipur, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate- Ist, Saidpur, Ghazipur and with the further prayer to stay the further proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case during pendency of the present application.
At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant states

entities.text: State vs. Mohd. Azam and Mohd Azam vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: that the applicant is ready for compromise and the matter be referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre, to which learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 states that there are no chances of mediation as earlier the matter was referred to the Mediation Centre vide order dated 15.6.2022 passed by a Division Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 6422 of 2022, Mohd. Azam And 5 Others Vs. State Of U.P. And 2 Others, but the applicant did not appear therein.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 6422 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Mohd. Azam And 5 Others Vs. State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: At this stage, learned counsel for the applicant states that the purpose of the applicant would suffice if an order is passed directing the trial court to decide the bail application of the applicant, as expeditiously as possible.
He further states that although the prayer has been made for quashing of the charge sheet, summoning order and the entire proceedings of the case but he does not press the same.
He further states that the applicant shall raise all the questions before the trial court.
Learned counsels for the State and the opposite party no. 2 have no objection of aforesaid arguments of learned counsel for the applicant.
In view of the above, the prayer for quashing of proceedings/summoning order/charge sheet is dismissed as not pressed.

However, in view of the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the limited prayer of learned counsel for the applicant, it is directed that if the accused-applicant surrenders before the trial court and applies for bail within two weeks from today, the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law.
Till the aforesaid period, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
It it clarified that if the accused-applicant does not appear before the court concerned by the said date, the court concerned shall proceed against him in accordance with law.
The present application is disposed of.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 18.1.2023 Naresh  Mohd Azam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62176480/
